observations: Three photos show a white PlayStation 5 console with two white DualSense controllers placed on a blue tufted fabric surface.
The console has a vertical black stripe down the center, characteristic of the PS5 Pro model.
The controllers are white with black grips and have the PlayStation logo on the analog sticks.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MC GAMES' is present on all photos.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage or wear.
